volume_avg.name: Volume Average
volume_avg.comment: Trung bình khối lượng n phiên

pvt_signal.name: Price Volume Trend Signal
pvt_signal.comment: Rolling normalized PVT signal adapted from quant-ohlcv-feature

volume_up_ratio.name: Up Volume Ratio
volume_up_ratio.comment: Rolling share of volume on bars where Close rises

volume_down_ratio.name: Down Volume Ratio
volume_down_ratio.comment: Rolling share of volume on bars where Close falls

money_flow_index.name: Money Flow Index
money_flow_index.comment: Volume-weighted positive and negative money flow oscillator

pvi.name: Positive Volume Index
pvi.comment: Cumulative close return on bars where Volume rises

nvi.name: Negative Volume Index
nvi.comment: Cumulative close return on bars where Volume falls

clv_ma.name: Close Location Value MA
clv_ma.comment: Rolling mean of (2 * Close - Low - High) / (High - Low)

wad.name: Williams Accumulation Distribution
wad.comment: Cumulative Williams AD normalized by its rolling mean

tmf.name: Twiggs Money Flow
tmf.comment: EMA of true-range volume flow divided by EMA volume

obv_clv.name: CLV-weighted OBV
obv_clv.comment: Rolling CLV-weighted volume normalized by its rolling mean

cmf.name: Chaikin Money Flow
cmf.comment: Rolling CLV-weighted volume divided by rolling volume

emv.name: Ease of Movement
emv.comment: Midpoint move divided by volume density per price range

directional_volume_change.name: Directional Volume Change
directional_volume_change.comment: Rolling maximum of quote-volume proxy change signed by close direction

quote_volume_reg.name: Quote Volume Regression
quote_volume_reg.comment: Rolling linear-regression fitted value of Close * Volume proxy

quote_volume_tsf.name: Quote Volume Time Series Forecast
quote_volume_tsf.comment: One-step rolling linear-regression forecast of Close * Volume proxy

price_volume_corr.name: Price Volume Correlation
price_volume_corr.comment: Rolling correlation between Close and Close * Volume proxy

quote_volume_sum.name: Quote Volume Sum
quote_volume_sum.comment: Rolling sum of Close * Volume quote-volume proxy

volume_bias_short_long.name: Volume Bias Short Long
volume_bias_short_long.comment: Short-window quote-volume proxy mean divided by long-window mean minus 1

volume_ratio_amount.name: Amount Volume Ratio
volume_ratio_amount.comment: (up amount + flat amount / 2) / (down amount + flat amount / 2)

adosc.name: Accumulation Distribution Oscillator
adosc.comment: Normalized EMA spread of cumulative CLV-weighted volume

wvad.name: Williams Variable Accumulation Distribution
wvad.comment: Normalized rolling sum of body-weighted volume

klinger_oscillator.name: Klinger Oscillator
klinger_oscillator.comment: Normalized EMA spread of signed volume by typical price direction

vra.name: Volatility-adjusted Rate Composite
vra.comment: Dual-horizon price ROC multiplied by rolling close volatility

ke.name: Momentum Volume Energy
ke.comment: Signed squared n-period price change amplified by normalized volume

volume_ma_bias.name: Volume MA Bias
volume_ma_bias.comment: Volume divided by its moving average minus 1

amv_signal.name: AMV Signal
amv_signal.comment: Rolling-normalized volume-weighted average of open-close midpoint

volume_ratio.name: Volume Ratio
volume_ratio.comment: Up-volume plus half neutral volume divided by down-volume plus half neutral volume

macd_volume_ratio.name: MACD Volume Ratio
macd_volume_ratio.comment: Volume MACD divided by its rolling signal minus 1

volume_analysis_oscillator.name: Volume Analysis Oscillator
volume_analysis_oscillator.comment: Short minus long average of volume weighted by close position versus candle midpoint
